mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns when either series shows growth below 0.3% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%) triggers a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO) indicates robust economic output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns when the series growth rate is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% monthly signals a healthy labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts growth (HOUST) exceeding 0.3% monthly indicates strong housing market activity, a leading indicator of consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST growth > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales growth (RSAFS) above 0.4% monthly signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.4%.
